gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Company totals cannot be assigned to the AI product line without direct attribution.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: AR, inventory and AP stock changes are not an AI cash-absorption measure.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: Dell 已披露 AI 动态提高库存、应收和应付，并说明大单会占用营运资金；但未披露 AI 产品级金额、周转天数桥或各科目由 AI 导致的具体增量。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 正式研究可使用方向和机制；如需量化归属，只接受 Dell 后续披露或独立受控估算，并明确标注为估算。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Do not call the gap closed or commercial while sixteen human-required packet items remain undecided.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Supplier capacity is industry context until Dell allocation is directly supported.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: No Dell capacity quantity or delivery share may be inferred.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 供应链资料能证明产品或制程在爬坡，但没有说明新增容量何时释放、其中多少分配给 Dell。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 后续只接受供应商官方产能时间表、Dell 自述或可验证的分配证据。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Do not declare non-disclosure until reachable official routes and candidate admission are receipted.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Supplier process metrics cannot be converted into Dell delivery metrics without a relationship bridge.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: No utilization or yield percentage may be inferred from ramp language.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 产品爬坡和先进制程收入占比不等于产能利用率或良率。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 寻找供应商 prepared remarks、产能/良率披露或保留商业数据缺口。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Preserve a commercial-data boundary if admissible sources remain unavailable after the full ladder.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Industry demand does not prove Dell order durability or customer inventory health.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: No pull-forward magnitude may be inferred from backlog or revenue co-movement.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 现有材料说明订单到交付可能非线性，也披露客户集中和取消风险，但没有量化本季是否存在提前采购或后续消化。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 后续定向查找订单取消、交付节奏、客户库存和管理层关于 pull-forward 或 digestion 的明确表述。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Retain an open commercial boundary while mandatory source routes or candidates remain unadjudicated.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Memory-industry evidence remains context unless the Dell delivery path is proved.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: No HBM quantity, yield or Dell share may be created from narrative context.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 美光候选讲 DDR5、SOCAMM2 和 SSD，没有 HBM 产能、良率或 Dell 分配。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 外源补充应定向 HBM 产能、供应紧张度和分配，而非泛内存新闻。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Generic memory news and unavailable routes do not prove a public-information boundary.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: The threshold is a research choice and must not be attributed to Dell or a supplier.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: Any numeric threshold is an owner-approved method parameter, not a reported fact.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 来源给出了风险和监控指标，但没有替研究者定义 thesis 失效阈值。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 阈值应由研究方法或用户假设冻结，不能伪装成公司披露。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Do not search indefinitely for a company-defined research threshold or present an unfrozen value as disclosed.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Reported metrics may feed the trigger, but the trigger rule belongs to the research method.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: Baseline facts remain S2 authority; trigger thresholds remain typed S3 parameters.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 资料给出可持续跟踪的订单、收入、利润、现金和监管风险，但没有替研究者定义可操作的季度失效阈值。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 由后续研究方法层基于基准值和用户风险偏好冻结阈值，并保持与公司披露分离。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Do not accept a generic continue-to-monitor statement as an executable WWC.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Peer or sector multiples cannot substitute for Dell point-in-time market facts.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: Market PIT and valuation calculations must be produced by the numeric authority layer.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 没有市场时点数据，不能判断增长预期是否已反映在价格中。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 后续绑定市场 PIT、估值区间与明确 as-of。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Do not present a price-in conclusion while the market PIT surface is absent.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Industry shipments or pricing may form scenarios but cannot become Dell bridge inputs without attribution.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: Price, volume and mix effects remain null until S2 has compatible authoritative inputs.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 公司披露 AI 服务器 mix 压低毛利率，但没有把收入变化拆成价格、台数和配置组合三部分。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 需要产品 ASP、出货量或可复算的配置桥；否则保持不可推断。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: PVM must remain null; no model or Writer may fill missing bridge terms.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Bundles and market samples cannot be substituted for Dell aggregate ASP.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: A bounded quote is not a company NumericFact and cannot be divided into an ASP.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 现有材料披露收入和 mix，但未披露 AI 服务器 ASP。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 优先寻找管理层 prepared remarks、产品价格数据或明确的价格/配置桥。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Do not compute PVM or company ASP from bundles, four-system procurement samples or industry prices.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Industry shipments and procurement quantities cannot be re-labeled as Dell company shipments.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: Units must be typed and period-aligned before they can enter ASP or PVM formulas.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: AI 服务器收入没有配套出货台数或等价算力单位。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 查找公司演示、产业出货数据或保留商业数据缺口。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Do not infer Dell units from industry share, contract bundles or component quantities.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Industry scenarios may inform assumptions but are not Dell reported facts.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: Every scenario value must be typed as an assumption or estimate, never an exact fact.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 尚未冻结估值假设和敏感度输入。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 由 Numeric Program 与用户假设共同生成可复算情景。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Do not generate model-memory valuation inputs or backfill a false exact point estimate.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: Supplier growth remains directional context and may not be presented as Dell-specific capacity.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: No supplier share or capacity amount may be assigned to Dell without a typed relationship bridge.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: MU、NVIDIA 和 TSMC 的自述可作行业供给背景，但现有来源没有把容量或供货份额明确归属到 Dell。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 后续保留行业 read-through 与 Dell 特定供给归因的边界，不能用行业增长替代 Dell 分配证据。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: Narrowed does not mean closed; preserve the Dell attribution boundary in the report.

gap_boundaries.company_vs_industry_boundary: A peer multiple is context until its period, metric and comparability are reconciled to Dell.
gap_boundaries.numeric_authority_boundary: Valuation inputs and formulas require period, unit and source lineage in S2.
gap_boundaries.why_it_matters_zh: 本地财报材料没有截至日市场价格和估值倍数。
gap_boundaries.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 后续接入 market PIT 或用户提供的估值时点。
gap_boundaries.stop_boundary: No valuation or price-in conclusion may be written from filing-only evidence.

boundary_register.why_it_matters_en: Company balance-sheet movements are only proxies until product attribution and a cash-flow reconciliation are available.
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 正式研究可使用方向和机制；如需量化归属，只接受 Dell 后续披露或独立受控估算，并明确标注为估算。
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: Qualified review of existing candidates followed, if still needed, by Dell product attribution, turnover or reconciled cash-flow disclosure.

boundary_register.label_zh: 供应产能释放时间与 Dell 分配
boundary_register.label_en: Supplier capacity release timing and Dell allocation
boundary_register.why_it_matters_zh: 供应链资料能证明产品或制程在爬坡，但没有说明新增容量何时释放、其中多少分配给 Dell。
boundary_register.why_it_matters_en: A supplier ramp does not establish when capacity becomes usable or how much reaches Dell.
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 后续只接受供应商官方产能时间表、Dell 自述或可验证的分配证据。
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: An official supplier timetable plus Dell disclosure or verifiable allocation evidence.

boundary_register.why_it_matters_zh: 产品爬坡和先进制程收入占比不等于产能利用率或良率。
boundary_register.why_it_matters_en: Product ramps and advanced-node revenue are not measurements of utilization or yield.

boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: Supplier prepared remarks or audited capacity, utilization or yield disclosure for the relevant period.

boundary_register.label_zh: 需求提前采购与后续消化
boundary_register.why_it_matters_zh: 现有材料说明订单到交付可能非线性，也披露客户集中和取消风险，但没有量化本季是否存在提前采购或后续消化。
boundary_register.why_it_matters_en: Backlog and revenue growth can coexist with customer concentration, cancellation risk or non-linear shipment timing.

boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: Bound statements or data on cancellations, delivery cadence, customer inventory, pull-forward or digestion.

boundary_register.why_it_matters_en: General memory commentary does not establish HBM availability, yield or Dell-specific allocation.
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 外源补充应定向 HBM 产能、供应紧张度和分配，而非泛内存新闻。
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: Admissible HBM capacity, tightness, yield or allocation evidence tied to the relevant period and relationship.

boundary_register.why_it_matters_zh: 来源给出了风险和监控指标，但没有替研究者定义 thesis 失效阈值。
boundary_register.why_it_matters_en: Observed risks cannot reverse a thesis consistently until materiality and threshold rules are frozen.
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 阈值应由研究方法或用户假设冻结，不能伪装成公司披露。
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: A preregistered research-method threshold tied to a metric or event, direction, window, owner and response route.

boundary_register.why_it_matters_zh: 资料给出可持续跟踪的订单、收入、利润、现金和监管风险，但没有替研究者定义可操作的季度失效阈值。
boundary_register.why_it_matters_en: A monitoring list is not operational unless each trigger has a direction, window, threshold authority and follow-up action.
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 由后续研究方法层基于基准值和用户风险偏好冻结阈值，并保持与公司披露分离。
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: A frozen method register using current baselines and owner risk preferences, kept separate from company disclosure.

boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 后续绑定市场 PIT、估值区间与明确 as-of。
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: A bound market price, valuation interval and explicit as-of date with comparable definitions.

boundary_register.why_it_matters_zh: 公司披露 AI 服务器 mix 压低毛利率，但没有把收入变化拆成价格、台数和配置组合三部分。
boundary_register.why_it_matters_en: Product revenue growth cannot be decomposed while price, unit and configuration weights are missing.

boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: Compatible Dell ASP, shipment units and mix weights with same-period reconciliation to reported revenue.

boundary_register.why_it_matters_zh: 现有材料披露收入和 mix，但未披露 AI 服务器 ASP。
boundary_register.why_it_matters_en: Revenue and mix disclosure do not reveal a company-wide AI-server average selling price.
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_zh: 优先寻找管理层 prepared remarks、产品价格数据或明确的价格/配置桥。
boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: Admitted Dell price or configuration evidence with a defined denominator and period, or an explicitly typed estimate.

boundary_register.what_evidence_would_change_en: Admitted Dell shipment or equivalent-unit evidence with period, entity and denominator definitions.
